description.en: Neon blocks rain down. Dodge them, graze near misses for combos, grab stars for coins and unlock new skins.
description.zh-TW: 霓虹方塊從天而降，閃避它們、擦邊連擊、收集星星換金幣，解鎖全新造型。

instructions.en: Drag anywhere to move (arrow keys work too). Slip close to a block for a near-miss combo, grab stars for coins to unlock skins, and pick up a shield to survive one hit.
instructions.zh-TW: 在畫面任意處拖曳移動（也可用方向鍵）。貼近方塊閃過可累積擦邊連擊，收集星星換金幣解鎖造型，拾取護盾可抵擋一次撞擊。
